decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Class A1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or any order revoking or re-enacting that order, the retail use shall not include the sale of food nor of clothing or footwear other than those normally associated with the DIY trade.
Condition : 2 - No industrial or storage activity shall be carried on outside the buildings without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall not be open to the public for trading, taking deliveries, or any other form of servicing outside the hours of 6.30am to 8.00pm on Mondays to Fridays and 7.00am to 8.00pm on Saturdays.
Condition : 5 - The development shall not be open for trading nor any plant associated with the development operated outside  the hours of 10am and 6pm on a Sunday.

Condition : 6 - Noise emitted from the buildings or plant associated with the buildings shall not exceed 45dB expressed as a 1-hour LAeg between 10am and 10pm, 40dB expressed as a 1-hour LAeg between 8am and 10am and 35dB expressed as a 5 minute LAeg at any time on a Sunday.
Condition : 7 - Servicing of the development shall not take place on a Sunday.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the reference to opening times deliveries and servicing shall be carried out in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan dated November 2016 prepared by Iceni Projects received on 31/03/2017.
description: Variation of condition 1 (opening hours) of planning permission 01252/W/P6 dated 02/07/1996 which varied condition 8 of original permission 01252/W/P2 dated 23/02/94, to allow the store to operate between the hours of 6:30am to 8:00pm Mondays to Fridays and 7:00am to 8:00pm on Saturdays
